key_reasoning.reason: Ten-plus non-test source files changed: REST models (category.py, hosted_application.py, hosted_application_requests.py), the router (hosted_applications.py), four hosted_applications service modules (catalog.py, projections.py, publication.py, and a brand-new categories.py async lookup), and the unrelated-subsystem assistant/category_service.py (extended delete-block logic to also check hosted applications). New abstraction (categories.py) plus multiple subsystems touched.

diffstat reports 30 files changed, 1400 insertions(+), 126 deletions(-) — includes 19 test files, one new alembic migration, and the OpenAPI baseline refresh. Per the actual-mode file-count mapping (16+ files -> XXL) this scores XXL even though the non-test implementation footprint is moderate.

Touches API (router + request/response models), Service (catalog/categories/projections/publication/category_service), and DB-Persistence (new `categories` JSONB column + GIN index added via src/external/alembic/versions/2394f0863c6a_add_hosted_application_categories.py) — 3 layers including a schema migration, matching the L band definition exactly ('3-4 layers including persistence — schema change or migration').

The new column/index mirrors the existing, already-proven workflows categories JSONB+GIN shape (migration docstring: 'same default and GIN index shape the workflows table uses'); category validation reuses the existing require_existing/categories_by_id pattern. Additive, backward-compatible, with a short lock_timeout safeguard and extensive new/updated test coverage (test_categories.py, test_schema_parity.py, test_query_plans.py, etc.), so risk stays at M rather than being bumped to the schema-change floor.
